propositions: Project rebar.toml must add [reconciler] table with rich_text_cutover = "cloud" to enable Jira Cloud ADF reconciliation

Legacy golden-equivalence test test_description_change_emits_description expects plain-wire payload and must explicitly set REBAR_RECONCILER_RICH_TEXT_CUTOVER=off in its backend fixture to isolate from project operational config
When rich_text_cutover is enabled at project level, the Jira reconciler emits ADF-canonical Markdown (with trailing newline) instead of plain-text payloads
rebar config must validate typed enum values for reconciler.rich_text_cutover to prevent invalid configurations
